basic_details.short_information: College of Art, Government of NCT of Delhi Non-Teaching Staff Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by the College of Art, Government of NCT of Delhi (affiliated to the University of Delhi) on its official website for the recruitment of 22 Part-Time Non-Teaching Staff posts for the academic year 2026-27. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for eligible candidates seeking part-time government jobs through a walk-in interview.

qualification.details: post: Qualification/ Experience | mechanic grade b: 10th pass; at least 3 years' experience in the trade (Lithographic Printing from stones and zinc plates, Intaglio Printing including other graphic printing techniques, maintenance of various machines related to printing work). Approved trade certificate is desirable. | carpenter: 10th pass; experience in carpentry for at least two years | moulder: Certificate/Diploma in metal casting from a recognised institute; knowledge of metal casting in the lost wax process including preparation of moulds, repair and patination of casting; two years' experience in the same field | dark room assistant: 10th pass; knowledge of the process of developing, handling photographic equipment and chemicals, table-top photography, and the ability to process colour and black & white films and bromides; experience of video photography | attendant/peon: 10th pass, preferably with English | dark room attendant: 10th pass; preferably about one year's experience working as Attendant in a Dark Room | gest (duplicating) operator: 10th pass with English; knowledge of handling a duplicating machine | electrician: 10th pass, preferably with English | library attendant: 10th pass

selection_process: Selection for Non-Teaching Staff posts will be made purely through a walk-in interview. The notification does not mention any written examination or skill test as part of the selection process.
how_to_apply: Visit the official College of Art website: http://colart.delhigovt.nic.in
Download the prescribed proforma along with Annexure 'A' and Annexure 'B' (self-assessment).
Fill the application form completely and attach the required original documents, self-attested photocopies, and two passport-size photographs.
Submit the completed application at the College of Art, 20-22, Tilak Marg, New Delhi-110001, on or before 28 July 2026.
Appear in person for the walk-in interview as per the specialization/post applied for, tentatively from 3 August 2026 onwards. Registration on each interview day is between 9:00 AM and 1:30 PM.
Check the official website regularly for the department-wise interview schedule.
important_instructions: Candidates must review the recruitment rules on the official website to confirm eligibility for the post applied for. If a candidate is found ineligible at any stage due to false declaration or submission of forged documents, the candidature will be cancelled and the candidate will be debarred from appearing in any future recruitment at the College, in addition to further action as deemed fit. No registration for the walk-in interview will be entertained after 1:30 PM on the scheduled date for a given specialization/post. For any query, candidates can contact the Principal, College of Art, 20-22, Tilak Marg, New Delhi-01.

Candidates interested in similar government opportunities in the region can also explore other Delhi Government Jobs, Delhi University Recruitment. Those looking for more part-time and guest faculty roles can also check the latest Part-Time Faculty Recruitment and Non-Teaching Staff Vacancies notifications from other Delhi Government colleges.

content_sections.heading: College of Art Delhi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice was issued in two stages. The first notice, dated 9 July 2026, asked candidates to submit the application form along with documents by 28 July 2026. A subsequent Detailed Notice states that the walk-in interview will tentatively begin from 3 August 2026 onwards, department-wise. Candidates should refer to both dates carefully.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for College of Art Delhi Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates must carry the following to the walk-in interview: Duly filled prescribed proforma (Annexure 'A') Duly filled Self-Assessment part (Annexure 'B') Original documents and certificates A set of self-attested photocopies of relevant documents (educational qualification certificates, experience certificates, etc.) Two recent passport-size photographs (colour, front-facing)
